Wave-2 block 23465435: the facility ProxyAdmin owner 0xcacc556744a9c8de12a627d570156aaa156edf4b is a verified OpenZeppelin TimelockController; getMinDelay() is 259200 seconds, its sole proposer/canceller is Safe 0xcfb72f136102559008e960aa33b94b2da94f3f88 (2-of-10), execution is open, and DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE is held only by the timelock itself. Both Safes return terminal empty module lists, zero guard words and fallback handler 0xfd0732dc9e303f09fcef3a7388ad10a83459ec99. These observations establish nested controller identities, not complete runtime/fallback noninterference or human key custody.

capSemanticsReview.rationale: Verified JMIExtension _wrap(asset,account,recipient,amount) requires the immutable SwapFacility, transfers the admitted asset, checks the actual balance increase, and only then mints decimal-normalized extension units; the inherited M wrap path transfers matching M first. The operational Safe can assign asset-cap managers and admit/raise non-M asset caps, but these powers do not bypass asset transfer. Collateral admission/value risk is Backing, not arbitrary issuance. Parent M issuance belongs to the inherited serial-claim edge; proxy upgrades are separate from D14.

review.evidence: Historical observation at RISE block 23375290: 4,186,507.178834 M backing against 4,166,902.771484 USDR supply; M-extension wrapping conserves deposited M. D14/D29 source review established that JMIExtension transfers the admitted asset and checks the actual balance increase before minting; cap managers may admit assets and raise caps, not bypass transfers. Continuous reconciliation describes this local wrap accounting, not upstream fiat/Treasury assurance or insolvency rights. Wave-3 RISE block 23553199 (0xa5bfb930fb08da99be8444001422f1bfcc74d389089ed3a1c9c1ed791aed14b3): token and facility EIP-1967 implementations remain 0xf9733d0bf530b02929ab81cf78e7d0befd3a2d7b and 0xf7f9638cb444d65e5a40bf5ff98ebe4ff319f04e, both bytecode-matched to verified source. Their ProxyAdmins still belong to token-owner Safe 0xc588c10a90c942ee3476877c4bac3d798e724856 and facility timelock 0xcacc556744a9c8de12a627d570156aaa156edf4b respectively. The timelock retains 259200 seconds, self-admin, open execution and proposer/canceller Safe 0xcfb72f136102559008e960aa33b94b2da94f3f88. Facility role-admin Safe 0x8c645e201dd944677864479357f8255ea943b18b is 3-of-5; proposer Safe is 2-of-10. Both proxies bytecode-match SafeProxy and resolve to Sourcify exact-match SafeL2 0x29fcb43b46531bca003ddc8fcb67ffe91900c762; all 15 owners have empty code, both complete module lists are empty, and guard/module-guard slots are zero. Their handler 0xfd0732dc9e303f09fcef3a7388ad10a83459ec99 bytecode-matches verified CompatibilityFallbackHandler: signature methods delegate validation to the Safe quorum, callbacks return acceptance selectors, and simulate calls simulateAndRevert, which unconditionally reverts all effects. Owner, threshold, module, guard and handler reconfiguration require Safe self-calls; generic quorum-authorized CALL/DELEGATECALL reach remains, not an issuance-only allowlist. Incremental token/facility/timelock role-grant and revoke census from 23465436 through 23553199 finds no changes, extending wave-2 complete histories. This answers the formerly missing nested runtime/fallback binding without asserting independent humans, custody, immutability or a governor-only issuance envelope. Incident review covers RISE-USDR token and these local mint/upgrade paths from May 2026 deployment through this pin: issuer product/blog security searches, M0 audit archive, exact-address incident search and prior role/control histories locate no known relevant mint incident. StablR/Tangible USDR are different assets. The August 3 RISEx XLP report concerns a separate USDC.e strategy; its canonical receipt 0xc52560bec154a3d5533a321bd9805305a5076194573ddb2fbb059059ace3e987 contains none of the USDR token/facility/controller addresses. Reviewed absence is not a guarantee against undisclosed incidents. Dedicated scoped human-independence and key-custody questions remain unanswered. No transaction was sent and no governed-issuance qualification is claimed.
